raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. ( precious stone ) berlian; ( of lower quality ) intan: ~ ear-rings, subang berlian; ~ cutting tool, perkakas pemotong intan; ~ drill, gerudi intan; 2. rhombus-shaped figure, bentuk potongan wajik; 3. figure printed on playing card, daiman: eight of ~s, lapan daiman; 4. playing card with this figure on it, kad daiman; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : ~ in the rough, (US) see ROUGH DIAMOND. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
